component.name: Open Couch
component.summary: Switch your desktop layout to the couch/TV and back, with one click
Alterne o layout do seu desktop para a TV/sala e volte, com um clique

description.p: Open Couch is a small utility for people who use the same PC both at a desk and on a couch connected to a TV (for example, running Steam Big Picture). It remembers your monitor/TV layout (resolution, scale, position), lets you switch to the "living room" layout with one click, launches Steam in Big Picture mode, and automatically restores your original desktop layout when you are done.

Open Couch e um pequeno utilitario para quem usa o mesmo PC tanto em uma mesa quanto em um sofa conectado a TV (por exemplo, rodando a Steam em modo Big Picture). Ele lembra o layout dos seus monitores/TV (resolucao, escala, posicao), permite alternar para o layout "sala" com um clique, abre a Steam em Big Picture e restaura automaticamente o layout original do desktop ao terminar.

ul.li: Guided setup to detect and configure your desktop and TV outputs
One-click switch between desktop and couch/TV layouts
Automatically launches and monitors Steam Big Picture mode
Restores your original layout when Steam closes
